snippet.title: ChoseAnyway: Card Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
Chosen Anyway is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder with permanent progression. Build your deck each run, face challenging bosses, and grow stronger as your cards scale with Ryn's RPG stats.

Wishlist Chosen Anyway on Steam:
